summary.intent: Resolve 7 PR review threads by fixing code issues, then reduce 36 TypeScript no-explicit-any lint warnings across test and source files.
summary.outcome: All 7 threads resolved and warnings reduced from 36 to 1 (one intentional `any` cast). Backend tests passed and changes were committed.

repo: The codebase has 9 files with no-explicit-any warnings, concentrated in test/SDK files: shares.service.spec.ts, sdk-core/perf.ts, integration.test.ts, load test workloads, and sdk-e2e test suites.
TextEditorDialog fallback behavior is an intentional H-02 security fix and should not be changed despite appearing as a code issue.
FolderIpns guard removal and upgradingId clearing were among the 6 substantive fixes in the PR review round.
One remaining `(mockShareRepo as any).manager` cast in shares.service.spec.ts is intentional and acceptable.

code.finding: Contains the one intentional remaining `any` cast: `(mockShareRepo as any).manager` — acceptable for mock typing.
Originally suspected to have an unused ForbiddenException import causing a lint error, but the error actually originated in ipns.service.ts and was already fixed.
Had an unused ForbiddenException import that was the actual source of the ESLint error attributed to error-cases.test.ts line 6.

workflow: Using an Agent tool to batch-fix lint warnings across many files is effective for repetitive no-explicit-any cleanup.
Verifying test passage after lint fixes before committing is the correct order of operations.
When ESLint output references a line number in one file, the root cause may actually be in a different file — verify before assuming.

friction: Counting warnings per file required multiple bash commands due to grouping/formatting issues in initial output.
A misleading ESLint error appeared to point to error-cases.test.ts line 6 but was actually in ipns.service.ts, causing unnecessary investigation.
open_items: The one remaining `(mockShareRepo as any).manager` cast in shares.service.spec.ts is a known typing limitation to revisit if a proper type for the mock repo manager becomes available.
